# Skabba Deals

> Clever, tested kitchen gadgets at fair prices. Free tracked shipping on US orders
> over $49. Buy any 2 items for 10% off, 3 or more for 20% off (applied
> automatically). 30-day returns.

Skabba Deals (https://skabbadeals.com/) is a small online store selling nine
kitchen gadgets: prep tools, cook tools, brew tools, and organization tools.
Orders are processed in 1–2 business days and arrive in about 6–15 business
days with tracking. Contact: hello@skabbadeals.com.
